answer: Decay-gated payout: each claim shrinks the task reward by a fixed fraction, carving a canyon into the pool so later claimants get less. The rule caps Nth-clone pay at r/N², yet every clone still pays full signing and compute cost to post into the ocean of claims. At N = 7 the per-identity overhead exceeds r/49, making the marginal clone at inlet position N > 7 strictly negative-EV.
